description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Lunafreya] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Lunafreya
description.text: Increases [Water Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Summoning or White Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Lunafreya after using two Water or Holy abilities (max 3), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Hydraean Protection+
description.text: Five single attacks (5.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, minimum damage 2000, restores 1000 HP to all allies

description.name: Spirit Attack: Lunafreya
description.text: Grants  [Magical +30% Boost 1]/[Damage +30% Boost 1] if 0-3/4+ FFXV allies are alive

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
